description: Select text on the page, from a target element or by finding an exact phrase.

occurrence.description: Which match to select when the text appears multiple times

search.description: Exact text to find and select, case-insensitive

target.description: Element whose entire text content to select

nth.description: Zero-based index when several elements match

role.description: Tag name or ARIA role to narrow matches, e.g. "button" or "link"

text.description: Case-insensitive visible text the element should contain

name: page_selectText
